{{Top|ca|leg|notoc=1}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' was a criminal living in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At one [[Time/Legends|time]], over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], the criminal ruined the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] for the people at a fancy [[Unidentified resort club|resort club]] that was in operation over Bespin. After the events at the club, the criminal left in the last available [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] at the club.<ref name="Rodeo">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021212thranta|series=Creature Feature|text=Rodeo Thranta}}</ref>
{{RPGseed}}
Shortly after the criminal left in the speeder, a group of individuals flew in pursuit on some retired [[air rodeo]] [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]] located at the club.<ref name="Rodeo" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The criminal first appeared as part of an adventure idea in "[[Rodeo Thranta]]," an article written by [[Jeff Quick]] as part of the ''[[Creature Feature]]'' series of articles for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Wizards.com|website]]. The article was released on [[December]] [[December 12|12]], [[2002]], with the adventure ideas and characters being usable by gamemasters at any time after thrantas were first used in air rodeos, which happened before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the thrantas' [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Rodeo" />
